activity_summary: Richard Cowley came at nine as far as the foot of the stair, which was as far as Mistress Ansell allowed, with today's part already learned. You began to give the reason for the second cut. He said a reason would not help an entrance. You settled it roll against roll. The second cut stands. You stayed in. She called the meal broth, and you called it water. You told him the eleven lines were struck and none kept.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the second cut, kept the reason, and stayed in.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Showed the part already learned, refused the reason, and took the second cut away with him.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Stopped him at the foot of the stair and set down the broth.

facets.activity: Settled the second cut, and stayed in
